Id1.text: The All India Council for Technical Education which is located in Mumbai gave Technical Campus status to the Acharya Institute of Technology. The institute is based in Bangalore, a city founded by Kempe Gowda I, its director is Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar and it is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University and its campus address is: Soldevanahalli , Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090.

Id2.text: The Acharya Institute of Technology was given the 'Technical Campus' status by the All India Council for Technical Education (located in Mumbai), and is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University. The director of Acharya is Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar. The Acharya Institute of Technology campus is located in Bangalore, of which the founder was Kempe Gowda I. The address is Soldevanahalli, Acharya Doctor Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Rd, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090.

Id3.text: The city of Bangalore, founded by Kempe Gowda I, is home to the Acharya Institute of Technology, a Technical Campus designated by the All India Council for Technical Education of Mumbai, affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University, directed by Dr G.P.
